definitions.explanation: A form of Japanese collaborative poetry where two or more poets take turns composing alternating verses of 5-7-5 and 7-7 syllables, building on each other's themes and imagery. Flourished from the Kamakura through Edo periods.

examples.japanese: {連歌|れんが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌人|かじん}→歌人：20522_kajin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詠|よ}む→詠む：14186_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Linked verse is composed by multiple poets.

examples.japanese: {室町時代|むろまちじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連歌|れんが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だった。
examples.english: Linked verse was most popular during the Muromachi period.

examples.japanese: {連歌|れんが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{句|く}→句：02137_ku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}み→詠む：14186_yomu⟧、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{句|く}→句：02137_ku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}ち→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}して→展開する：25229_tenkaisuru⟧いく。
examples.english: In linked verse, participants take turns composing stanzas, developing the poem while maintaining a connection to the previous verse.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Linked verse originated from the upper and lower halves of the ⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧ (waka) being composed by different people. Major practitioners include {宗祇|そうぎ} (Sōgi) in the Muromachi period. The more informal, humorous variant {俳諧|はいかい}{連歌|れんが} eventually gave rise to ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧ (haiku) through the work of ⟦{松尾芭蕉|まつおばしょう}→松尾芭蕉：30772_matsuobashou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連歌|れんが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}む→詠む：14186_yomu⟧ (to compose linked verse)
- {連歌|れんが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (a linked verse gathering)
- {連歌|れんが}{師|し} (linked verse master)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧: haiku — a standalone 5-7-5 verse, descended from the opening verse of {連歌|れんが}
- ⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧: waka — a 5-7-5-7-7 verse composed by a single poet
